scripts.examples: node sequencer.js -y -i ../examples/example1.yml -o -f; node sequencer.js -y -i ../examples/example2.yml -o -f; node sequencer.js -y -i ../examples/example3.yml -o -f; node sequencer.js -y -i ../examples/example4.yml -o -f
